viewportExceptions.reason: The legacy daily-calendar page expands its page-wide inline size at the reviewed light 390px viewport; this exception records the known page lease boundary.
viewportExceptions.rationale: The current measured html overflow is a documented legacy page finding, so only this exact page, mode, width, and selector are reviewed.
viewportExceptions.remediation: Rework the daily-calendar page shell and its injected navigation so the document reflows within the phone viewport.

viewportExceptions.reason: The legacy daily-calendar body follows the reviewed page-wide width expansion at the light 390px viewport; this exception does not waive any other body finding.
viewportExceptions.rationale: The current measured body overflow is a documented legacy page finding, so only this exact page, mode, width, and selector are reviewed.
viewportExceptions.remediation: Remove the daily-calendar body's fixed-width contributors and restore a viewport-contained page layout.

viewportExceptions.reason: The injected legacy navigation region retains a wide internal link row at the reviewed light 390px viewport; only that local region is reviewed here.
viewportExceptions.rationale: The current measured navigation overflow is an explicitly listed local-content finding for this page, mode, and width.
viewportExceptions.remediation: Refactor the daily-calendar navigation region to reflow its links without horizontal scrolling.

viewportExceptions.reason: The legacy daily-calendar content container projects the reviewed phone overflow through its child schedule layout.
viewportExceptions.rationale: The current measured container overflow is an explicitly listed local-content finding for this page, mode, and width.
viewportExceptions.remediation: Make the daily-calendar container and its child grid use min-inline-size: 0 and a single-column phone layout.

viewportExceptions.reason: The sleep schedule summary keeps a legacy fixed-width row that scrolls locally at the reviewed light 390px viewport.
viewportExceptions.rationale: The current measured schedule overflow is an explicitly listed local-content finding for this page, mode, and width.
viewportExceptions.remediation: Allow schedule items to wrap or stack below the phone breakpoint.

viewportExceptions.reason: The injected authentication control contributes to the reviewed drawer-local legacy width at the light 390px viewport.

viewportExceptions.reason: The injected theme button group is a documented local scroll contributor in the reviewed legacy drawer at the light 390px viewport.

limitations: Static mode checks cannot prove computed contrast, focus visibility, dialog focus restoration, or keyboard traversal.
Axe findings and active unobscured screenshots require the local browser path.

waivers.reason: The local browser matrix observed pre-existing serious/critical axe findings across unleased legacy pages. This explicit baseline waiver records the current debt while the gate remains fatal for findings outside the reviewed matrix and for all runtime, focus, control, viewport, and asset failures. Page ownership is required before remediation; this is not a release claim of zero accessibility debt.
